scope: Read-only official public sites, official developer docs and MetaCubeX rule sources; no credentials/login/trading/network configuration changes. Hostname classification, not promise of app completeness.

brokers.name: Longbridge / LongPort
brokers.notes: User explicitly requests Longbridge HK routing. Entire shared Longbridge family follows HK preference, including .sg and CN API access domains. .cn is an access point, not an account jurisdiction. Homepage HTML explicitly references assets.lbctrl.com, assets.lbkrs.com, assets.wbrks.com; new API/quote/trade under longbridge.com/.cn; old longportapp.cn included for legacy SDK compatibility. Does not establish all private App endpoints or actual login success.

brokers.name: Futu Hong Kong dedicated domains
brokers.notes: Root official site and upstream dedicated HK names. futunn.com and futustatic.com are shared services; do not assign the whole Futu/Moomoo upstream list to HK.

brokers.name: Webull Hong Kong
brokers.notes: Official homepage links hktrade.wbsecurities.com. Shared webullfintech.com serves both HK and US; do not classify root by country.

brokers.name: Tiger Hong Kong dedicated domain
brokers.notes: Official HK entity and contact domain. itiger.com/hk and /sg share the same hostname; hostname rules cannot distinguish paths.

brokers.name: Schwab / thinkorswim
brokers.notes: US group based on user Schwab/TOS usage. Official download page links tosmediaserver.schwab.com and trade.thinkorswim.com. Existing schwab.tech/schwabcloud.com supplementary rules retain prior evidence. Upstream also includes schwab.com.hk/.com.sg/.co.uk; assign those dedicated regional websites separately if desired. Shared schwab.com login cannot infer account country.

brokers.name: Fidelity US
brokers.notes: US official investing site. Do not use fidelityinternational.com for this entry.

brokers.name: ETrade
brokers.notes: Official US retail brokerage and login site; root includes us.etrade.com.

brokers.name: Robinhood
brokers.notes: Official root redirects to /us/en and HTML references cdn.robinhood.com/docs.robinhood.com. Other countries also use paths on robinhood.com: this US preference applies that shared root host, cannot infer account country. No guessed private API domains added.

brokers.name: Webull US website
brokers.notes: US site and app.webull.com. Shared trading, quotes and static services on webullfintech.com must remain shared.

brokers.name: Vanguard US website
brokers.notes: All exact hosts referenced by official US investor homepage HTML. Vanguard root has multinational services; avoid classifying every vanguard.com hostname US.

brokers.name: Phillip Singapore
brokers.notes: Official Singapore brokerage and PhillipCapital sites.

brokers.name: Tiger Singapore dedicated domain
brokers.notes: Official SG HTML links www.tigerbrokers.com.sg and developer.tigerbrokers.com.sg. itiger.com itself shared by region URL path.

brokers.name: Futu Singapore dedicated domain
brokers.notes: Dedicated legacy SG domain from upstream; moomoo.com/sg response was 403, no authenticated testing. Shared moomoo.com cannot infer SG account merely from website path.

brokers.name: Futu / Moomoo shared services
brokers.notes: HK homepage references passport.futunn.com, q.futunn.com and cdn.futustatic.com; Moomoo SG public response also references cdn.futustatic.com. Keep shared hosts in manually selectable general finance unless user chooses whole family HK/SG.

brokers.name: Webull shared service hosts
brokers.notes: Both official homepages reference quotes-gw.webullfintech.com, trade.webullfintech.com and wbstatic.webullfintech.com. Shared same host cannot be split by account region.

brokers.name: Tiger shared services
brokers.notes: Official SG page references download.tigerfintech.com, da.tigerfintech.com, static.tigerbbs.com and www.itigerup.com. itiger.com region lives in URL path. Do not assign whole family to HK or SG absent user preference.

brokers.name: Interactive Brokers shared family
brokers.notes: Retain existing general finance provider for account/session consistency. Regional website does not prove shared account gateway location; do not classify entire IBKR US.

recommendation: HK/US/SG brokers independent manual groups; leave multi-region shared API/asset roots in general finance unless explicit family-wide preference. Longbridge whole family follows explicit HK preference. Shared domains cannot infer URL path, account jurisdiction or service region.
